items.html: The matter is that we have explained that this Malchut of the general SAG has three Heys in the Hey of internality and three Heys in the Hey of externality. Now, the third, lowest Hey of the externality, which is the phase of the externality of the NHY of this Malchut of SAG, descended within ZA of Atzilut to make for him internal Mochin, as is known.
